book.name: Hebreos
book.title: CART DANꞋ NYOJ C̱HE BEṈEꞋ HEBREO CAꞋ

content: Beṉe' migw, Diosen' ba gwleje' chio' naccho ḻo ne'e, na' cheyaḻa' goncho xbab c̱he Cristo Jesús ben' gwseḻe'. Naque' bx̱oz blao c̱hecho na' ben' chejnilaže'cho.
Jesúsen' bene' cayaṉen' gwna Dios ben' gwseḻa' ḻe' šlac gwde' yežlion', ca'cze ben da' Moisésen' cate' ḻe' goclene' da' x̱ozxta'ocho ca' cani', beṉe' ca' gosac diaža c̱he Dios.
Perw Jesúsen' zaca'che' ca da' Moisésen', ḻe ḻen' bx̱ie' diaža c̱he Diosen', na' da' Moisésen' naque' con to beṉe' za' ḻo diaža c̱he Diosen'.
Gwnita' beṉac̱h beṉe' bx̱ie' to to diaža yežlio nga, san ca nac Diosen', ḻen' bx̱ie' yogo'te da' zjade.

Da' Moisésen' goque' ca xmos Diosen' cate' bene' con can' gwna Diosen' cont goclene' da' x̱ozxta'ocho beṉe' ca' gosaque' diaža c̱he Diosen'. Na' da' Moisésen' be'e diža' c̱he da' za' gac da' za' c̱hix̱jue'e Diosen' beṉac̱hen' ca tiempa'.

Perw Criston' bi goque' ca to mos dan' gwzoe' bene' can' gwna Diosen', san da' naque' Xi'iṉ Diosen' da'nan' bene' can' gwnen', na' naque' X̱an yogo' chio' naccho diaža c̱he Diosen'. Na' da' ḻi naccho diaža c̱he Diosen' še zoac̱hac̱hcho chejnilaže'chone' na' chebecho ṉezecho gac güen c̱hecho.
Da'nan' cheyaḻa' gwzenagcho can' ža Spiritw c̱he Diosen' len da' nga da' nyojen, žan:

content.text: bi gonḻe güedenag can' goson da' x̱ozxta'ole cani' cate' besyedabague' Diosen' latje daš gan' chesaše'.
Bi gosejḻe'e še leda' dan' goša' ḻegaque' gwnežjua' da' yesezaca'zi'e ṉec̱he xtoḻa'gaquen'.
Bi gosejḻe'e c̱hia' cate' gosaše' latje dašen', ḻa'czḻa' c̱hoa iz besele'ede' can' bena' len ḻegaque'.
Da'nan' bža'a beṉe' ca' gwnitan' na' gwnia':
na' bi chosozenague' c̱hia' cont yesone' can' chazlažan'.”
Nachen' bža'a ḻegaque' na' da' baḻi gwlo'a gwnia':
“Gwbat ṉite' mbalaz yesyezi'laže' can' chezi'laža' neda'.”

content: Beṉe' migw, bi güe'le latje ṉabia' da' malen' yic̱hjlažda'ole na' gonen cont cuejyic̱hjle bich šejnilaže'le Diosen' ben' zoa toḻi tocaṉe.
Na' šlac ṉa'a ṉe' decze latje gwzenagcho c̱he Diosen', ḻe ṉeyoe ḻježle tža tža cont ṉe tole bi gonḻe xbaben' clele, gaquele bibi nonen gontezle da' xiṉj.
Da' ḻi naccho Criston' txen še ṉe' zoacho chejnilaže'chone' cate' žin ža gatcho, con can' gwzolaocho chejnilaže'chone'.
Nyoj Xtiža' Diosen' c̱he chio', žan:

content.text: bi gonḻe güedenag can' goson da' x̱ozxta'ole cani' cate' besyedabague' Diosen'.

content: Na' da' žan ca', choen' diža' c̱he da' x̱ozxta'ocho ca' bebej da' Moisésen' nación gan' nzi' Egipto. Gosende' can' gož Diosen' ḻegaque', perw bi bosozenague', besyedabague' Diosen'.
Da'nan' c̱hoa iz Diosen' bže'e ḻegaque' ṉec̱he gosone' da' xiṉjen', na' gosat ben' besyedabague' Diosen' šlac ṉe' zjalaže' latje dašen'.
Na' ḻegaque', da' bi bosozenague' c̱he Diosen', da' baḻi gwlo'e, gwne' bi güe'e latje yesenite' mbalaz yesyezi'laže' can' chezi'laže' Diosen'.
Na' nacbia' da' bi gosejḻe'e c̱he Diosen', da'nan' bi goc ṉite' mbalaz yesyezi'laže' can' chezi'laže' ḻe'.
